mechanism: Prednisone causes renal potassium wasting and hypokalemia through mineralocorticoid effects and increased urinary potassium excretion, which is antagonized by potassium supplementation.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly during prednisone therapy; supplement potassium if levels fall below 3.5 mEq/L or as clinically indicated; consider concurrent potassium-sparing diuretics if appropriate.
